parcalar.metin: Celtic have never faced Beşiktaş. That changes tonight, at Celtic Park.
Beşiktaş were founded in Istanbul in 1903. They're one of the city's big three, and their nickname is the Black Eagles.
This season they beat Marseille four-one, won three-two at Hoffenheim, and drew two-two with Crystal Palace.
Celtic's only Turkish opponent so far? Fenerbahçe, in 2015. One-one, and two-two.
After three games, Beşiktaş have seven points. Celtic have zero.
